invariants.statement: vNext transport requests only use role writer or reviewer.
invariants.test_hint: Build each selected stage request and assert role in {'writer','reviewer'}; unknown stage fails before request creation.

invariants.statement: Stage request identity is deterministic from public prompt and response schema through existing request_sha256.
invariants.test_hint: Rebuild request twice from same manifest and inputs; request_sha256 and job_id must match.

invariants.statement: Deleting projection cache does not change reconstructed next action.
invariants.test_hint: Remove vnext/projection.json and replay manifest plus ledger; next action is identical.

invariants.statement: Ledger parent hash chain must be intact before any request, adapter or handoff action.
invariants.test_hint: Mutate a historical ledger event and assert WVO-FC-ARTIFACT_TAMPER.

invariants.statement: An accepted stage with matching schema, identity, request SHA, response SHA and artifact SHA is not resent.
invariants.test_hint: Run two ticks after accepting a stage and assert no additional outbox file appears.

invariants.statement: Any request job_id collision with different request bytes fails closed.
invariants.test_hint: Seed outbox with same job id and altered payload; vNext tick raises WVO-FC-REQUEST_COLLISION.

invariants.statement: Ambiguous next action is terminal until repaired.
invariants.test_hint: Create duplicate valid next stage sequences and assert WVO-FC-AMBIGUOUS_NEXT_ACTION or schema rejection.

invariants.statement: Publisher handoff preserves legacy candidate and review identity.
invariants.test_hint: Compare artifact_sha256(candidate.json) before and after sidecar validation; Publisher must not rewrite candidate.

invariants.statement: Invalid vNext sidecar blocks opt-in Publisher collect-ready, while absent sidecar remains legacy-compatible.
invariants.test_hint: Run collect_ready with absent sidecar and with tampered sidecar; only tampered opt-in blocks.

invariants.statement: A run without vNext manifest always follows existing legacy coordinator behavior.
invariants.test_hint: Existing outbox cross-tick writer/reviewer test remains unchanged.

invariants.statement: vNext opt-in requires explicit EditorialManifestV1 mode and never runs as shadow A/B.
invariants.test_hint: Brief with partial vNext artifacts and no valid manifest fails closed.

invariants.statement: Integration cannot proceed unless both reviewed commit lineages are readable and represented in changed-file inventory.
invariants.test_hint: Integration preflight rejects missing Writer contract or Runtime Authority candidate/review objects.
